Capture your screen, mark it up, record it. Everything runs on your own computer.

**New in this version:** Linux works on Wayland desktops and inside a Flatpak (recording and live streaming use the desktop's own screen sharing, where you pick the screen); a Linux menu entry and store listing; `docs/AI.md` says which parts of Snagster are AI-generated. **New in 0.10.1:** Recent lists the pictures and videos you took before; capture a window from a list; one Snagster at a time; Settings and dialogs in their own centered windows; choose which graphics card encodes. **New in 0.10:** go live on several services at once (Twitch, YouTube and more) from one encode, up to 4K at 60 fps; Studio is the live workspace, with scene buttons and per-scene sound (up to 6 sources per scene) while you stream; choose the video encoder (or leave it on Automatic, which falls back by itself); NVIDIA graphics chips on Linux; the window never stops answering while it saves, exports or opens files; and `snagster --hw-report` to test graphics-chip encoding on your computer.

## Download

Pick your computer and click **Download**. Nothing to install.

| Your computer | Download | Then |
|---|---|---|
| 🪟 **Windows** 10 or 11 | **[⬇️ Download for Windows](https://github.com/SoloSaftis/Snagster/releases/download/__TAG__/Snagster-windows-x64-portable.zip)** | Open the downloaded folder and double-click **Snagster** |
| 🍎 **Mac** with Apple chip (M1 or newer) | **[⬇️ Download for Mac](https://github.com/SoloSaftis/Snagster/releases/download/__TAG__/Snagster-macos-arm64.zip)** | Open the download and drag **Snagster** to Applications |
| 🐧 **Linux** | **[⬇️ Download for Linux](https://github.com/SoloSaftis/Snagster/releases/download/__TAG__/Snagster-linux-x86_64.AppImage)** | Right-click the file → Properties → allow running as a program, then double-click it |

## The first time you open it

The app is not signed yet, so your computer may warn you once:

- **Windows** says "Windows protected your PC": click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Mac** says Apple "could not verify" Snagster: click **Done**, open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**. Then allow Snagster under **Screen Recording**.
